==Description==
'''v1.7.3''' is the fifty-fourth update to be released on Tower Defense Simulator, on the 12th of May 2023. It added the [[Ducky Crate]].

This version encompassed two updates, the main v1.7.3 Update (released 12 May 2023) and the minor v1.7.3a Update (released 23 May 2023).

==Changes & Bugfixes==
*The cash counter now has a $ symbol next to the {{Money|Cash}} amount.
*Corrected [[Cold Front Crate]] ad in the store listing its price as {{Coins|5,000}} instead of {{Coins|4,000}}.
*Fixed GUI sometimes not appearing in the game.
*Fixed Rotate and Placement Cancel buttons overlapping with Run and Emote buttons on mobile when a tower is being placed.
*Fixed fifth tower slot displaying that it has a {{Level|10}} requirement instead of {{Level|15}} in matches.
*Fixed some towers having an upgrade cost with decimals in [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode.
